formulaBlock.normalization: Aqua (Water) one entry; asterisk markers (* on Aloe juice, ** on fragrance items) stripped and kept as provenance; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C5): Sodium Coco-Sulfate (2) is the defining alkyl-sulfate anionic, with at least two prominent buffers (Lauryl Glucoside 3, Coco-Glucoside 4, Disodium Cocoyl Glutamate 8, Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate 11) and no reinforcing strong anionic.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Alkyl sulfate is the harsher class, plus Maris Sal (5); no refatting.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led; the only care routes are three hydrolyzed proteins (13-15), Arginine (10) and a late cationic amino-acid conditioner PCA Ethyl Cocoyl Arginate (19). No cationic polymer, silicone, lipid or pearlizing route.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: PCA Ethyl Cocoyl Arginate is an antistatic cationic and three proteins add some film; together they could give noticeable slip (neighbor moderate).

weightPotential.rationale: Low: only hydrolyzed proteins and a late cationic arginate conditioner, facing a buffered coco-sulfate chassis; no polymer, silicone or lipid.

depositionLoad.rationale: Hydrolyzed corn/wheat/soy protein (13-15), PCA Ethyl Cocoyl Arginate (19).

persistence.rationale: Hydrolyzed proteins and a small cationic surfactant are weakly retained.

resetCapacity.rationale: C5 coco-sulfate with glucoside and glutamate buffers.

context_humectants.note: not a deliberate humectant route (C2 R11)

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Light, weakly retained routes and moderate reset: low anchor.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: two families present, but they are hydrolyzed proteins (light film) and one late cationic surfactant listed after salt near the preservatives; no persistent polymer, silicone or lipid exists, so noticeable residue is implausible.

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Care-direction verdict provisional: nonspecific (three hydrolyzed proteins without a deposition system are a weak repair cue; a protein token alone is not repair_supported).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: CSA formula half NOT met: no prominent E4 comfort or humectant route (Aloe juice and Arginine are not listed).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole in the complete INCI.
